title: interview answers (v1)
description: The user's answers to one `interview-round.v1` round, written by the `vinta-ai-maestro` interview server to `<interview-dir>/answers/round-NN.json` when the browser form is submitted. The agent reads it back, scans for gaps and open questions, and writes the next round (or drafts the artefact). Lives at `<interview-dir>/answers/round-NN.json`, beside the round it answers. Written by `vinta-ai-maestro interview` when the page submits; read by the agent once `vinta-ai-maestro interview wait` returns. GENERATED from packages/vinta-ai-maestro/src/interview/document.ts — edit there, not here. See schemas/README.md for versioning rules.

submitted_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp set by the server on write.

answers.description: One entry per decision in the round, in round order.

questions.description: Questions the user asked the agent while answering. Reply to every one in the next round's `replies[]` (quote the question, answer in Markdown), and re-ask the decision if the answer could change it.

general_note.description: Free text the user wants carried into the artefact, not tied to one decision.

status.description: `answered` — a value is present; `waived` — user marked it not applicable (treat as explicitly out of scope, not as unknown); `skipped` — left open (only possible for `required: false` decisions). A `skipped` required-looking decision is **Open questions** material.

values.description: Chosen option `value`s. One for `single` / `confirm`, any number for `multi`. Empty when the user only used `other`.

other.description: Free text from the "Something else" card.

note.description: Optional nuance the user attached to this decision. Quote it in the spec rather than paraphrasing it away.

decision_id.description: Decision the question is about, or `null` for a general question.
